# S543 — Start tracking commit includes retire moves, so a new worktree has no active copy of a retired slice

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**2026-11-25** — The start commit commits a retired or done item's slice-file move and render with the index only when both the active and the done/retired slice file are dirty, so an in-place edit of a done file stays with the owner; verified by engine tests, mutation checks and a green full suite.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Observed 2026-11-24 on S510. Three slices (S502, S532, S534) were retired on main with `slicer retire`, which moves each `.slicer/slices/ID.json` to `.slicer/slices/retired/ID.json` and updates `.slicer/index.json`. `ork run ork S510` then made the commit "Tracking edits on main before starting S510" (a54310dc). It committed `.slicer/index.json` (now saying the three are retired) and S510's own files, but not the three moves. The worktree was branched from that commit, so it had index status `retired` with the files still in `.slicer/slices/`. `slicer done S510` then failed `slicer check`: "S502: slice file is in the wrong folder for status 'retired'" (and S532, S534). The orchestrator fixed it by hand in the worktree. The same failure hit S448/S439 and S476/S477/S346 earlier.

The start commit must leave the tree consistent: if it commits `.slicer/index.json`, it must also commit every slice-file move and render that the index change reflects (or commit none of them). Design choice for the owner when this is specced.

Expected: the commit holds the index, each moved item's deleted and new slice file and its render; S700 stays dirty. Red: only the index is committed.
- `TestLaunchTrackingLeavesInPlaceDoneEdit` (`internal/engine/landdirty_test.go`): a done item edited in place (file and render) with the index dirty. Expected: the commit holds the index alone; the done file and render stay dirty. Red: both are committed.
- `TestLaunchTrackingLeavesMovesWithoutIndex` (`internal/engine/landdirty_test.go`): a move with no index change makes no commit.

## Implement

Owner decisions (2026-11-25): Which tracking files does the start commit add when it commits `.slicer/index.json` and the index change comes from a retire move? -> moves and renders: also commit each slice-file move (the deleted `.slicer/slices/ID.json` and the new `.slicer/slices/retired/ID.json`, or `done/`) and each affected `.slicer/render/slices/ID.md`. Leave other dirty tracking files alone, as the code does today. [run.start-commit-tracking-moves].
